title: Open-Meteo historical archive — Lewa grid point, mid-May and late June 2016–2025
claims: The requested grid point at 0.197 N, 37.123 E returns an elevation of 2,132 m, above the conservancy's running area (official pages quote 5,500–6,000 ft, about 1,676–1,830 m).

Mid-May window (13–17 May 2016–2025, 50 day-samples): daily high 20.2–25.0 °C median 22.0 °C; daily low 7.9–12.3 °C median 10.8 °C; precipitation ≥1 mm on 27 of 50 days, ≥5 mm on 6 of 50; single-day maximum 20.1 mm.

Late-June window (24–28 June 2016–2025, 50 day-samples): daily high 18.6–24.2 °C median 21.0 °C; daily low 7.7–12.8 °C median 9.4 °C; precipitation ≥1 mm on 24 of 50 days, ≥5 mm on 8 of 50; single-day maximum 17.6 mm.

These are modelled grid-point reanalysis values, not measurements on the race course; the grid sits higher than the conservancy floor, so on-course readings should be expected somewhat warmer, with dust and direct sun adding heat stress.

verification.checkedVia: PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod 读取 Open-Meteo archive API JSON，分别过滤每年 5 月 13–17 日与 6 月 24–28 日，重算 min/median/max 与降水计数
verification.note: 2027 届定于 5 月 15 日；6 月窗口数据仅用于对照历史 6 月办赛气候。
